acceptanceCriteria: A test invokes the SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit adapters twice, more than 60 s apart in simulated time, against an unchanged repository, task text and session key, and asserts the model-visible packet bytes are identical.
Any field that legitimately varies per invocation is moved out of the model-visible packet or documented in the host-adapter spec with the reason it must vary.
The result is recorded with packet byte counts for both invocations.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the owner's request to learn from claude-mem (github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem, shallow clone at bfc50259f64a, 2026-10-03). Its plans/20-project-identity-and-injection-scope.md found that minute-granularity timestamps in injected SessionStart and file-context headers changed the bytes every 60 s and defeated Anthropic prefix caching, and that the same file context was re-injected on every Read of an unchanged file. Their acceptance test: two SessionStart injections 61 s apart must be byte-identical, and an unchanged file injects once per session. Corvint's hook packets carry revision, status and request digests; this has not been checked: whether any field (timestamps, request digests, nonces, map ordering) varies across invocations when the repository, task and session are unchanged. Related: V1-0296 (per-prompt hook cost) and completed V1-0240 (session-start digest cap). Not a confirmed defect.

completion.reason: All three criteria met by beamfall/corvint#521, merged 2026-10-04T14:04:24Z as 8cc127b3 via auto-merge. Evidence digests = sha256 at main cd70ba0a of docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0713-byte-stable-packets.md and cmd/corvint/host_adapter_stability_test.go: (1) the test runs session-start (startup, resume) and user-prompt three times in a testing/synctest bubble 61 s and 25 h apart on the fake clock against an unchanged fixture and asserts identical bytes, requiring a full envelope so equal fallbacks cannot pass; (2) no model-visible field varies with the clock; the deadline-outcome and changed-state exemptions are documented in AHI-043 (agent-harness-integration-v0.md), deadline variance tracked by V1-0607; (3) byte counts recorded: session-start 3,336 and user-prompt 3,646 on every run, plus a real-binary run 61 s apart (169 and 3,481 identical bytes). Mutation check (appending time.Now()) failed the test. Limits: policy-bearing packets not covered by the test bytes; real Claude Code cache-hit rate NOT_OBSERVED; make gate NOT_RUN.

title: hosts: injected context packets are byte-stable for an unchanged repository so prompt caching holds
